fact: On 15 April 2025 AGEFAU's acting director general and the director general of SMTD discussed reactivating their convention of September 2022 and involving SMTD in the project to set up a telecommunications network for the collectivités territoriales, and agreed that their technical directorates would work on sustaining AGEFAU's investments.
title: Le Directeur Général par intérim reçu par le Directeur Général de la Société Malienne de Transmission et de Diffusion, M Cheick Oumar Traoré de la SMTD
